title: The Hills Betray the Fleeing Khalsa at Basohli

blocks.text: Thereafter, toward Basohli the battered Singhs marched on without provisions, rest, or trustworthy allies. Seeing a large assembly of hill people, some of them hoped for relief and approached in good faith, only to find that the gathering had no intention of sheltering them.

Instead, hill forces slaughtered many Singhs on the spot and handed others over to the Mughals, who cut them down immediately. The same pattern unfolded around Parol and Kathuha, where fleeing Singhs were trapped, seized, and destroyed rather than allowed to pass through in safety.

Driven toward the hills as a last resort, the survivors discovered that forces already summoned by the Nawab of Lahore had occupied the heights above them. Pressed from the slopes and from the rear, they fought with blunted weapons, searched in vain for Lakhpat Rai, and finally turned towards the river in hope of finding some way out.
